name: Network Ray Marching Iterator
aliases: Distributed Ray Marching with Macrocell DDA
definition: A variant of ray marching designed for networked/distributed rendering (likely using NVIDIA OptiX or similar ray tracing APIs). It tracks ray 'alive' status across blocks and uses `block_any` for divergence control, integrating adaptive sampling within macrocells.
summary: The Network Ray Marching Iterator is a distributed ray marching algorithm that uses block-level divergence control to manage thread synchronization across macrocell boundaries in networked GPU rendering environments.
